title: Ericsson reports fourth quarter results and full-year results 2024
paragraphs: Sales increased by 2%* YoY, with 54%* growth in market area North America. Market area Europe and Latin America also grew, while the other market areas declined significantly. Reported sales were SEK 72.9 (71.9) b.
Sales declined by -5%*, impacted by a -6%* sales decrease in Networks. Reported sales were SEK 247.9 (263.4) b.

In 2024 sales grew by 17% YoY, which was exceptional given market conditions. Growth was driven by strong demand for private 5G and neutral host solutions, as well as customer contract renewals, and expansion in WWAN & Security solutions. In Q4, sales growth also accelerated, boosting momentum heading into 2025.
